tiles.title: Version 11.3.1.4 improves Azure ingress traffic control and network security through an upgraded network policy enforcement architecture, moves the Host and SPU container images to Red Hat UBI 9 (RHEL 9.8) for all Fully Managed (SaaS) and BYOC deployments on AWS and Azure, and upgrades INZA to version 11.3.7. The infrastructure changes are applied automatically, so users and administrators don't need to take any action.

Version 11.3.1.3 introduces IBM Netezza Nexus (open lakehouse catalog in private tech preview), a built-in vector store and unstructured data support for AI workloads, a native Node.js driver, JDBC and ODBC connection retry options, nzcli enhancements (nz manualvacuum, nzsqa, setup-lh-connection), Advanced Monitoring, SOC 2 Type 2 attestation for AWS, and INZA 11.3.6 support.
This release introduces custom CIDR support for BYOC deployments, streamlines the Administration console with consolidated navigation, and upgrades INZA to version 11.3.5.
Version 11.3.1.1 introduces hostname verification for SSL/TLS connections, unique cloud storage requirements, BYOC resource release optimization, and improved API server URL accessibility.
Enhanced BYOC deployment with improved serviceability, Amazon S3 IAM role support, and INZA 11.3.4 integration with cryptographic hashing capabilities.

This release introduces native Azure Blob and AWS S3 support for Netezza tables on object storage, IAM-based access for AWS buckets, an integrated AI Database Assistant, enhanced Iceberg table management with REST catalog and BYOC, customer-managed encryption keys for AWS, improved SSL/TLS certificate validation for OLEDB, accurate client IP logging for AWS private instances, certificate download from the console, optimized query history loading, and better backup scheduling during daylight saving changes.
